definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese art of espionage, sabotage, and unconventional warfare practiced by ninja. Encompasses stealth, disguise, martial arts, survival skills, and various other techniques. In modern usage, also refers to the fictionalized version of these skills depicted in manga and anime.
